items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: Slide Hampton can do the same thing, being able to play and being able to write.

ctx.x: So let me ask you, back to yourself, musically what’s your favorite thing to do?

To play. I like to play more than anything, but my Dad told me something and I never really thought about it, I’m starting to think about it more, he said, “Players come and go, you’ll see. You’ll see great ones, but if you can write well you can make it.” And he found that out. And he was really unique though, Monk, because he could actually play well and he could write well. And see some guys don’t have to — Slide Hampton can do the same thing, being able to play and being able to write. So I really need to…

took forever. You know you’re dealing with Sibelius and you’re going back and forth and trying to make that stuff work and Hubert is [scats] all this stuff. But I do want to get into writing more. I want to.
